progressData.title: Consultation & Planning
progressData.text: We meet with you to understand project requirements, assess site conditions, and develop a comprehensive execution plan with safety and compliance in mind.

progressData.title: Mobilization & Execution
progressData.text: Our skilled team and equipment are deployed to site. We manage all operations including plant maintenance, construction, or fuel system installations efficiently.

progressData.title: Quality Assurance & Handover
progressData.text: We conduct thorough inspections, ensure all safety standards are met, and deliver completed project on time with full documentation and client sign-off.
